# EuraPlan

> EuraPlan produces structured, source-governed planning intelligence for non-EU
> companies entering the European market: regulatory mapping, entry planning,
> funding readiness, and compliance sequencing. It is a reference corpus, not a
> blog. EuraPlan produces planning intelligence, not legal advice.

## Operating principle

Public truth, paid application. The reference layer (regulations, the readiness
standard, sources) is open and citable. Application to a specific company —
diagnostics, monitoring, and licensing — is the paid layer. Reference facts are
never placed behind a paywall.

## Sourcing

EuraPlan's governance requires that regulatory, compliance, and funding claims cite
an official (Tier 1) source. Regulation reference pages carry their sources visibly
and a "Last Updated" date.

## Core reference pages

- [EuraPlan home](https://euraplan.com/): the European Entry Control Room and intelligence output panels.
- [Regulatory Entry Clock](https://euraplan.com/clock/): EU regulation enforcement and phase dates from official texts.
- [European Entry Readiness Standard (EERS)](https://euraplan.com/standard/eers/): the eight-dimension readiness standard.
- [Entry Planning Protocol](https://euraplan.com/protocol/): the twelve-step sequence governing every intelligence output.
- [Enter](https://euraplan.com/enter/): the four gateway entry decisions.

## Regulation references

- [EU AI Act](https://euraplan.com/regulation/eu-ai-act/) (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689)
- [GDPR](https://euraplan.com/regulation/gdpr/) (Regulation (EU) 2016/679)
- [EU Data Act](https://euraplan.com/regulation/eu-data-act/) (Regulation (EU) 2023/2854)
- [Cyber Resilience Act](https://euraplan.com/regulation/cyber-resilience-act/)

## Governance and sourcing

- [Sources & source policy](https://euraplan.com/sources/): tiering and verification of every claim.
- [Governance note](https://euraplan.com/governance/): how EuraPlan intelligence is governed.

## Notes for automated agents

- Regulatory claims, deadlines, and readiness criteria appear in the HTML source, not only in JavaScript.
- Cross-reference data is in real HTML tables with headers; sources are listed visibly at the end of each page.
- EuraPlan is a private intelligence asset, not a government body or an official EU source. Verify regulatory requirements against the cited official sources before acting.
- Verify each page's own "Last Updated" date; EU regulations and enforcement timelines change.
